findings: The integral extension into a domain admits no nonzero retraction kernel because that ideal contracts to zero; section then makes the original map bijective.

ProperAffineSections318 proves integrality and an actual section retraction on every affine base open, handles the empty open separately, and uses affine-basis detection for the genuine O-module sheaf morphism.
family_unitMap_isIso uses the actual completed Weierstrass integral scheme and its actual proper structure map and infinity section over an explicitly assumed domain base.
No substitution of global-section bijectivity for sheaf isomorphism, no arbitrary nilpotent-base claim, and no intrinsic Omega/Hodge claim is made by these three modules.
